free_tier.stated: Per-GB-month; "Just 4.99 Dollar per TB for 30 days"; multi-region redundant
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: NOT free, and this is the trap. Verbatim from the price list: "Outgoing public traffic | For the first 2 TB (<= 2 TB) | Free / The next 8 TB (> 2 TB <= 10 TB) | $0.036/GB / The next 40 TB (> 10 TB <= 50 TB) | $0.030/GB". All reads, writes ("Data Storage (write)") and requests are free. Only egress is metered. Outgoing traffic from user-owned buckets is always charged as regular public traffic.

chaining: Only viable behind Cloudflare, which converts the $36/TB egress into CF's free egress.
limits_note: `per-object`/class limits not the issue. The tiered egress ladder is. Above 150 TB it drops to $0.018/GB but never reaches zero.
reliability_note: Solid multi-region EU/US infrastructure; the pricing model simply assumes you do not read your data.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

evidence.proved: "Unbeatable price-performance ratio at $4.99/TB"; "Data Storage (write) | Free", "Data Retrieval (read) | Free", "PUT / COPY / POST / LIST | Free", "GET | Free"; "Data transmission costs are not included and will be added according to the current pricing"

"Outgoing public traffic: first 2 TB Free; next 8 TB $0.036/GB; next 40 TB $0.030/GB; next 100 TB $0.024/GB; over 150 TB $0.018/GB"; "Outgoing Object Storage traffic from user-owned buckets is always charged as regular public traffic"

price_per_tb_month: $4.99/TB at 5 TB and 20 TB for storage — but serving 20 TB/month costs $648 in egress alone (2 TB free + 18 TB x $36/TB), i.e. effective $32/TB+.
